import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { users } from "./users";
import { oauthApplications } from "./oauth_applications";
import { oauthOpenidRequests } from "./oauth_openid_requests";

// ⚠ Not reproduced exactly by `rebase db push` — read before pushing:
//   - "token" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - "scopes" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - "code_challenge" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - "code_challenge_method" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
export const oauthAccessGrants = defineTable("oauth_access_grants", {
    columns: {
        id: col.bigserial({ mode: "number" }).primaryKey(),
        resourceOwnerId: col.bigint({ mode: "number" }).notNull(),
        applicationId: col.bigint({ mode: "number" }).notNull(),
        token: col.text().notNull().unique(),
        expiresIn: col.integer().notNull(),
        redirectUri: col.text().notNull().validate({ url: true }),
        createdAt: col.custom({ dataType: "timestamp without time zone" }).notNull(),
        revokedAt: col.custom({ dataType: "timestamp without time zone" }),
        scopes: col.text().notNull().default(""),
        codeChallenge: col.text(),
        codeChallengeMethod: col.text()
    },
    relations: {
        resourceOwner: rel.belongsTo(() => users, { onDelete: "no action" }),
        application: rel.belongsTo(() => oauthApplications, { onDelete: "no action" }),
        oauth_openid_requests: rel.hasMany(() => oauthOpenidRequests, { foreignKey: "access_grant_id" })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
